environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS cluster. The HMAC_SIGNING_KEY is injected as a plaintext environment variable from a Kubernetes Secret (opaque type). The downstream payment-service validates requests by checking x-request-signature using the same shared HMAC key. The Ktor gateway is exposed via an AWS NLB (Layer 4) with no request inspection. No Envoy sidecar or service mesh policy is applied. The payment-service trusts any gRPC metadata header prefixed with 'x-admin-' for privilege escalation (legacy admin bypass).

config.secrets: K8s Secret mounted as env var HMAC_SIGNING_KEY=base64-decoded plaintext
config.downstream_trust: payment-service honors x-admin-override metadata for elevated privileges
config.signing: Application-level HMAC using in-memory key from env var
